verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS CRM, but the evidence pack never documents any telemetry setting, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking control. The only privacy-related item is a privacy-preserving image proxy in the SDK, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
